targeted_controls.scope: Five plan-selected unchanged fixtures, eight balanced ABBA+BAAB rounds. Every product has 84 measured observations per boundary, all checked raw medians/means and original RSS retained. This targeted decision evidence remains separate from the full-17 cohorts and isolated-source correctness inventory.

measurement.optional_control_scope: The planned five-fixture controls above explicitly bind accepted fusion 6764 versus the fold candidate. Other optional saved reports preserve their own labels/raw identities and do not inherit an ambient baseline or enlarge isolated-source correctness coverage.
measurement.boundaries: Initial full-17 ABBA compares fold-only against accepted fusion 6764. Isolation full-17 ABBA compares the same fold-only candidate against frozen combined 6cd, as measure-isolation.py explicitly overrides its baseline bindings. Original compiler-disabled fresh Store/Realm execution, strict-derived retained calls, ordinary runtime_baseline and Node fresh-context references remain separate boundaries. Source/harness/checksums, all startup controls and raw identities are checked.
measurement.memory: Post-execution smaps process RSS with Store alive is not live JavaScript bytes, peak memory or per-owner attribution. Whole-child GNU time peaks include loading/compiler and identity hashing. Isolation comparison is a separate experiment, not causal subtraction across differing baseline/source cohorts.
measurement.resource_policy: Inherited managed-cloud 32 GiB cap; CPU 0 for measurements/tests, quota-bound build CPUs; serial Cargo/libtest and retained module cache 512 entries/2 GiB. Swap/group OOM settings are inherited, not local 4 GiB guarantees.

runtime_code_size.limits: Verified own frozen executables decoded as bounded inert ELF data only. No payload loaded/executed, no child mapping capture, and no executed-function/page/RSS or causal memory claim. Extracted ELF files must stay outside the published inert archive.

limits: Only 54 selected native checks and eight complete original Test262 families are isolated-source correctness coverage; no combined-source inventory is adopted.
Selected replays are not full pinned-suite publication or full release acceptance; published benchmark graphs and full Test262 status remain unchanged.
Every-case V8/Scriptc execution-time and RSS parity remains open; optional comparisons do not establish universal parity.
Initial/confirmation accepted-baseline results and isolation combined-baseline results have explicit separate identities and must not be merged as one before/after cohort.
All 17 original, retained, ordinary and V8 controls and startup raw results remain visible, including slower controls.
Static code-site folding preserves dynamic counts/order; inert native byte diagnostics alone establish no executed-page, RSS or time benefit.

archive.exclusions: Only regular non-executable files are admitted; symlinks, special files, native/serialized suffixes, ELF/PE and Scriptw native-envelope magic, caches and next unimplemented patches are excluded. Raw WebAssembly, .smaps, and regular capture files named stdout/stderr/control are retained as data.
